description: End-to-end workflow to design, simulate, deploy, monitor, and optimize LPWAN IoT connectivity campaigns from initial design to device activation and billing conversion.

campaign_id.description: Identifier of an LPWAN connectivity campaign

network_profile_id.description: Identifier of a reusable LPWAN network configuration profile (e.g., LoRaWAN, NB-IoT settings)

device_batch_id.description: Identifier for a batch of devices to be onboarded in a campaign

simulation_id.description: Identifier of a coverage or traffic simulation run

deployment_id.description: Identifier of a network deployment attempt associated with a campaign

activation_token.description: Short-lived token used for binding devices to campaign and tenant

device_id.description: Logical identifier of an IoT device within the LPWAN service

org_user_id.description: Identifier for a user/operator within the tenant organization

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: search_network_profiles
functions.description: Search and filter reusable LPWAN network profiles suitable for a new campaign.

tenant_id.description: Tenant requesting available profiles; if omitted, returns global defaults only.

query.description: Free-text search across profile names, descriptions, and tags.

filters.description: Structured filters for profile capabilities and constraints.

supports_roaming.description: Whether profiles should support roaming between operators.

max_uplink_rate.description: Filter by maximum uplink rate per device.

security_level.description: Security posture expected for the profile.

functions.returns: Paginated list of candidate network_profile_id values with basic capabilities and metadata.

functions.name: create_campaign
functions.description: Create a new LPWAN connectivity campaign with target geography, device characteristics, and goals.

tenant_id.description: Tenant under which the campaign is created.

description.description: Detailed description of the campaign use case.

lpwan_technology.description: LPWAN technology to be used in the campaign.

network_profile_id.description: Optional preset network profile; if missing, a default based on lpwan_technology is used.

sites.description: List of location descriptors if type != nationwide.

coordinates.description: Geo coordinates of the site center.

radius_m.description: Approximate radius in meters covered around the site.

indoor.description: Indicates whether the deployment is primarily indoor.

countries.description: Applicable if type is nationwide or multi-national.

device_profile.description: Expected device behavior in the campaign.

mobility.description: Expected mobility of devices in the campaign.

business_goals.description: High-level business KPIs and constraints for the campaign.

target_activation_rate.description: Target percentage of devices to be successfully activated.

max_monthly_connectivity_cost.description: Budget cap for monthly connectivity cost.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata, such as external system IDs or notes.

functions.returns: Newly created campaign_id with initial status, resolved network_profile_id, and summary of inferred parameters.

functions.name: simulate_coverage_and_capacity
functions.description: Run a coverage and capacity simulation for a campaign using radio, terrain, and traffic assumptions.

campaign_id.description: Campaign for which the simulation is run.

tenant_id.description: Tenant owning the campaign; used for quota and access checks.

radio_parameters.description: Fine-grained radio configuration overriding profile defaults.

tx_power_dbm.description: Transmission power for devices in dBm.

antenna_gain_dbi.description: Antenna gain used for base stations.

duty_cycle_limit.description: Regional duty cycle constraints as a percentage.

building_density.description: Building density in the deployment area.

custom_obstacles.description: Optional custom RF obstacles to account for.

polygon.description: List of lat/lng vertices forming polygon.

attenuation_db.description: Additional attenuation introduced by this obstacle.

traffic_overrides.description: Optional overrides of campaign device_profile.traffic_pattern for simulation-only what-if analysis.

notify.description: Notification preferences when simulation completes or fails.

functions.returns: simulation_id with queued or running status and an initial estimate summary for coverage and capacity.

functions.name: review_simulation_results
functions.description: Retrieve and review simulation results to decide if the campaign is viable or needs adjustments.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response.

max_tiles.description: Limit number of coverage tiles returned when requesting raw_tiles.

functions.returns: Simulation status, KPIs (coverage %, blocking probability, headroom), and optionally heatmaps and per-site breakdowns.

functions.name: prepare_device_batch
functions.description: Prepare a batch of devices (identities and keys) for onboarding into the campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign into which these devices will be onboarded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant for which the batch is prepared.

batch_label.description: Human-readable label for the device batch.

device_template.description: Template defining device type and credentials provisioning scheme.

credential_scheme.description: How devices authenticate with the network.

key_provisioning.description: How to assign security keys or credentials.

import_reference.description: Reference to an external file or KMS key set (if mode != generate).

encryption_profile_id.description: Reference to an encryption profile used if external_kms.

quantity.description: Number of devices to prepare in this batch.

labeling_options.description: Optional automatic labeling or grouping of devices.

prefix.description: String prefix for device IDs in this batch.

start_index.description: Start index used when generating sequential device IDs.

group_tags.description: Tags applied to all devices in this batch.

callback.description: Optional callback settings when batch is ready.

functions.returns: device_batch_id with provisioning summary, estimated completion time, and initial activation_token for the batch.

functions.name: issue_activation_tokens
functions.description: Generate or refresh activation tokens for devices or batches, enabling device-side onboarding flows.

devices.description: Required if scope is single_device or bulk_devices.

external_serial.description: Optional external serial number used by manufacturers.

one_time_use.description: Whether the token becomes invalid after first successful activation.

bind_to_ip.description: If true, token is bound to originating IP when first used.

functions.returns: List of issued activation_token values with associated device or batch references and expiry timestamps.

functions.name: deploy_campaign_network
functions.description: Trigger deployment of the underlying LPWAN network resources and routing for a campaign.

deployment_mode.description: Intensity and isolation level of the deployment.

resource_overrides.description: Optional overrides for network resource allocation.

max_gateways.description: Maximum number of gateways to allocate for this campaign.

peering_policy.description: How traffic is peered across operators.

rollback_policy.description: Automatic rollback rules in case deployment fails or KPIs are not met.

on_failure.description: What to do if deployment fails.

max_activation_failure_rate.description: If activation failure rate (0-1) exceeds this threshold after grace period, auto-rollback may trigger.

grace_period_minutes.description: Grace period in minutes before KPI-based rollback checks.

notification.description: How to notify stakeholders about deployment progress.

functions.returns: deployment_id with initial deployment status, timeline estimates, and applied resource configuration.

functions.name: get_campaign_status
functions.description: Get current status and KPIs for a campaign, including deployment, onboarding, and activation metrics.

include.description: Extra data to include in the response.

time_window.description: Optional time window for KPI aggregation.

functions.returns: Current campaign lifecycle state, deployment and activation KPIs, error counts, and optional billing previews.

functions.name: list_onboarding_issues
functions.description: List and categorize device onboarding and activation issues for a campaign to support targeted remediation.

campaign_id.description: Campaign whose onboarding issues should be listed.

functions.returns: Paginated list of onboarding issues per device or batch, with classifications and suggested remediation actions.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_deployment
functions.description: Retry a failed deployment step or perform a partial/full rollback for a problematic campaign deployment.

action.description: High-level requested action on the deployment.

retry_policy.description: Optional fine-grained retry behavior when action is retry_failed_steps.

fixed_delay_seconds.description: Delay between retries for fixed strategy.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for retry or rollback, for audit logging.

requested_by.description: org_user_id of the operator triggering this action.

functions.returns: Updated deployment status, summary of steps queued for retry or rollback, and any irreversible impacts.

functions.name: activate_devices
functions.description: Perform or confirm activation of one or more devices into an LPWAN campaign and network.

campaign_id.description: Campaign that devices are being activated into.

activation_token.description: Activation token obtained via issue_activation_tokens or embedded in device manufacturing.

devices.description: Devices to activate under this token.

device_id.description: Logical device ID; may be server-assigned if not provided for some technologies.

device_batch_id.description: Optional batch identifier this device belongs to.

hardware_identifiers.description: Physical identifiers presented by the device.

initial_config.description: Optional initial configuration overrides for this device.

activation_mode.description: If validate_only, checks feasibility without committing changes.

functions.returns: Per-device activation or validation results, including assigned device_id where applicable and any errors per device.

functions.name: update_campaign_and_network_settings
functions.description: Update campaign-level business settings and underlying network parameters post-deployment.

updates.description: Fields that can be updated for an active campaign.

network_parameters.description: Network-related parameters that can be tuned.

allowed_geographies.description: List of ISO country codes or regional identifiers where devices are allowed to roam.

endpoint.description: URL, topic, or connector identifier depending on type.

change_reason.description: Reason for updating the campaign, for audit trail.

functions.returns: Updated campaign and network configuration snapshot with versioning information and any parameters pending rollout.

functions.name: convert_to_billing_and_close_campaign
functions.description: Finalize an LPWAN campaign by converting active usage into billing plans and closing or archiving the campaign.

billing_options.description: Options for how the campaign should be billed long term.

term_months.description: Contract term length for recurring plans.

include_test_traffic.description: Whether to include test or pilot traffic in billed usage.

device_migration.description: What to do with devices after the campaign is closed.

target_campaign_id.description: If action is move_to_another_campaign, the target campaign.

selection.description: Selection of devices affected by this rule.

archive.description: If true, campaign will be archived after conversion; otherwise kept visible as closed.

dry_run.description: If true, compute billing and migration outcome without applying changes.

functions.returns: Billing conversion summary, projected recurring charges, and final campaign status, or a simulation of these if dry_run is true.

functions.name: search_lpwan_campaign_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across lpwan_campaign entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching lpwan_campaign entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_lpwan_campaign_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N lpwan_campaign records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_lpwan_campaign_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many lpwan_campaign records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_lpwan_campaign_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many lpwan_campaign records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_lpwan_campaign_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of lpwan_campaign data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_lpwan_campaign_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a lpwan_campaign dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_lpwan_campaign_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more lpwan_campaign entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_lpwan_campaign_snapshot
functions.description: Restore lpwan_campaign state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_lpwan_campaign_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the lpwan_campaign workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_lpwan_campaign_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across lpwan_campaign metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_lpwan_campaign_audit_events
functions.description: Search the lpwan_campaign audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_lpwan_campaign_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers lpwan_campaign workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_lpwan_campaign_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for lpwan_campaign events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_lpwan_campaign_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for lpwan_campaign events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_lpwan_campaign_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off lpwan_campaign job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_lpwan_campaign_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled lpwan_campaign jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_lpwan_campaign_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled lpwan_campaign job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_lpwan_campaign_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a lpwan_campaign operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_lpwan_campaign_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a lpwan_campaign action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_lpwan_campaign_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a lpwan_campaign approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_lpwan_campaign_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any lpwan_campaign entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_lpwan_campaign_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a lpwan_campaign entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_lpwan_campaign_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling lpwan_campaign behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_lpwan_campaign_policies
functions.description: List lpwan_campaign policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_lpwan_campaign_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two lpwan_campaign-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_lpwan_campaign_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a lpwan_campaign entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_lpwan_campaign_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many lpwan_campaign entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
